beats.caption: Clarlougheask, in the civil parish of Donegal and the barony of Tirhugh. Here is the story of Clarlougheask and its fifteen families, from 1873 to 1926.
The parish register of Tawnawilly records four baptisms at Clarlougheask between 1873 and 1875. Its marriage entries give no townland, so none are placed here.
Mary Murray was baptised on 21 June 1874. Thomas Murray and Catherine Cunningham were the parents.
The censuses of 1901, 1911 and 1926 counted 61, 48 and 37 people in Clarlougheask, in 12, 12 and 8 households. Heads of household included Martin, Boyce and Breslin.
